css: .pfs-footer{--pfs-footer-muted:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 62%,transparent);--pfs-footer-gap:.5rem 1.25rem;--pfs-footer-size:.875rem;border-top:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 14%,transparent);font-size:var(--pfs-footer-size);line-height:1.5;color:inherit}.pfs-footer__inner{max-width:72rem;margin:0 auto;padding:.85rem 1rem;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;text-align:center}.pfs-footer a{color:var(--pfs-footer-muted);text-decoration:none}.pfs-footer a:hover,.pfs-footer a:focus-visible{color:inherit;text-decoration:underline}.pfs-footer__links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem 1rem}.pfs-footer__ring{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:.4rem}.pfs-footer__badges{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:.4rem}.pfs-footer a.pfs-footer__badge{display:inline-block;line-height:0}.pfs-footer__badge img{display:block;width:200px;height:44px;max-width:100%}.pfs-footer__badge--site img{width:auto;height:auto}.pfs-footer__badge--publisher img{width:32px;height:32px;max-width:none;object-fit:contain}.pfs-footer__badge--square img{width:32px;height:32px;max-width:none;object-fit:contain}.pfs-footer__news{display:flex;justify-content:center}.pfs-footer__sub{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem;margin:0;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}.pfs-footer__sub input[type=email]{font:inherit;font-size:.8125rem;color:inherit;background:transparent;width:13.5rem;max-width:62vw;padding:.2rem .5rem;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 25%,transparent);border-radius:.35rem}.pfs-footer__sub input[type=email]::placeholder{color:var(--pfs-footer-muted);opacity:1}.pfs-footer__sub input[type=email]:focus-visible{outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 45%,transparent);outline-offset:1px}.pfs-footer__sub button{font:inherit;font-size:.8125rem;color:var(--pfs-footer-muted);background:transparent;padding:.2rem .6rem;border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 25%,transparent);border-radius:.35rem;cursor:pointer}.pfs-footer__sub button:hover,.pfs-footer__sub button:focus-visible{color:inherit}.pfs-footer__hp{position:absolute!important;left:-9999px!important;width:1px;height:1px;opacity:0}.pfs-footer__sub+.pfs-footer__sublink{display:none}.pfs-footer__msg{flex-basis:100%;text-align:center;font-size:.8125rem;color:var(--pfs-footer-muted)}.pfs-footer__msg:empty{display:none}.pfs-footer__msg[data-state=ok]{color:inherit}.pfs-footer__msg[data-state=error]{color:#d92d20;color:light-dark(#b42318,#f97066)}.pfs-footer__copy{margin:0;color:var(--pfs-footer-muted)}.pfs-footer__copy a{color:inherit}.pfs-footer__brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;vertical-align:middle;margin-inline:.35rem;padding:2px 4px;border-radius:3px;background:#202124;line-height:0}.pfs-footer__brand img{display:block;width:20px;height:11px;max-width:none}
